limits: Choose max(prompt,slow) within each individual pulse; independent big-pulse and B1 maxima plus storage/history form a conservative all-phase envelope, not a solved event-by-event surface history.
Photon shapes and local energy transfer are conditional proxies, not measured frequency-dependent transport. Their alternatives are not credible intervals.
The k4 skin adds the full100um resistance on a bound to K+U+delayed surface heat flux without changing bulk conductivity. Contact impedance remains a separate qualification.
The lower of the first-interaction depth proxy and all-surface reference is used within the respective homogeneous photon model; secondary transport and layered heat flow remain unsolved.
All source heat is retained in the backing for storage; no thin-receiver capture fraction is silently set to99%.
